options.say: A man who pays through a second man, so that he has paid nobody. It is a common arrangement here. I hold paper on both of them.

options.text: You hold paper on the Improvement Company?
options.say: On rather a lot of it. They come in on Thursdays. They are very warm to me on Thursdays.

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: Mr. Pike's shirts are still here. Four of them, pressed.

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: He has not called for them in six years. The undertaker will tell you why.

options.say: A man who leaves four good shirts for six years is dead or married, Mr. Grubb. I checked the register.

options.text: Was the Colonel in the Eleventh Ohio Mounted?
options.say: There is no Eleventh Ohio Mounted. There is a Ninth. My brother was in it.
You have two dollars and forty cents. I have watched you spend the rest. You are not a careful man, Mr. Grubb, but you are an entertaining one.

repeats.say: You do not. I would have heard.
Mr. Grubb, I keep your accounts better than you do, and I do not keep your accounts.

options.text: Have you ever been in the Liar's Assay?

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: Once. A Company man told me, 'The Improvement Company came to me on their knees.' I said, 'The Company comes to everyone on their knees. It is how they get under the door.'

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: He paid his account the next morning. In full.

options.text: I am going to leave now, in a dignified manner.

opening.speaker: sheng
opening.line: Information is money that has learned to read. Sit down.

options.say: I will read it to you, when you have done me a service. Reverend Sowerby owes me for nine funerals' linens. He pays only on funeral days, because only on funeral days does he have money. Collect it.

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: Then I will read. A ledger leaves this room, my customers leave town.

exchange.speaker: sheng
exchange.line: And on the Company's own books, a line you will want: Claim Two, contingent, eleven thousand dollars.

options.say: You need two dollars and sixty cents, and you will have it at ten per cent, and you will pay it back, because I have watched you and you are honest in the one way that matters: absently.
You are the first customer in nine years whose collar and whose story got dirty in the same place. It suggests the story is true.

options.text: What do you think is under Claim One?
options.say: Nothing. What is under a story? More story.

options.text: Do you ever take a day off?
options.say: On Sundays I do no laundry. I do only banking. It is very restful.
options.repeat: On Sundays. Banking only. Nobody believes me, which is also restful.

options.text: I am going to leave now, in a dignified manner.
